lines.text: Many learners say: My phone is different with yours.
Better: My phone is different from yours.
From! This is different from that.

data.wrong: My phone is different with yours.
data.right: My phone is different from yours.

native.tip: 한국어 “~와 다르다”의 ‘와’를 with로 옮기기 쉬워요. different 뒤엔 from을 써요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “My phone is different from yours.”

en.tip: After different, say from. Say “My phone is different from yours.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “My phone is different with yours.” After different, say from. Right: “My phone is different from yours.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
